notes.title: Well, I screwed up (the leaderboards)
notes.content:
If anyone checks the leaderboards and notices their max wave is wrong, it's my fault (and I'm trying to fix it). In a recent "lag reduction attempt" update (uploaded 1/12) I introduced some buggy code that would set a players' max wave on every map to 51 due to a faulty assumption the player had unlocked all achievements / completed all maps; anyone that's played since then should have been affected (NOTE: This only affects leaderboard entries, not achievements or anything else).

Unfortunately, while I can delete faulty leaderboards entries I can't find any indication Steam saves leaderboard history, nor does it look like I can find 'new leaderboard records' on players' profiles. I'm reaching out to Steam support to see if there's anything I've missed and in the meantime I've tried reverting the leaderboards to what I remember them being before 1/12, but may have made mistakes.

I honestly have no idea if anyone who plays even looks at leaderboards, but if you do check the leaderboards and see your score is wrong please don't hesitate to dm or comment and I'll update it. **Important to mention you will have to launch the game first (not play, just quickly launch) for the leaderboard to be fully up to date.

Anyway, just want to be transparent in case anyone noticed their leaderboard score was completely wrong & apologize for the screw up. Hopefully if you don't care about leaderboards I didn't bore you to death with this essay of an update and this will be the last post like this I make. Future posts should return to being about eating spaghetti, existential dread, and mentioning the occasional new feature :)

notes.title: Really reaching for content with this one
notes.content:
Every map has 2 collectable journal entries, pieces will drop during gameplay & hint to easter egg completion steps & reveal backstory of the map / game. Does a free 2D pixel art graphics zombie shooter need a backstory? Eh f*ck it, it's more content.

The journal entries can be accessed on a screen that shows a "realistic" version of each map, generated by AI. Now I promise ya'll this is the only time I will use AI here, never again. This game is completely made through organic human work and thought, this is the only exception, I promise.

Next update i'll add achievements or something idfk I'm just gonna ask AI to generate and code the whole thing.
